{{Top|leg}}
'''Jedi Underground''' was the name used to delineate the individuals who aided the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in escaping persecution by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. Many of these same individuals were instrumental in creating the [[Great River]].
